structuredContent.body:
Adds two opt-in, currently unconsumed secure listener helpers for Refs #3720. They capture the existing generation/listener/port/host ownership and return a ready predicate only after strict verification. Superseded attempts and expected-host mismatch refuse without STOP; genuine still-owned readiness loss has narrow cleanup. Production is exactly main plus 37 added lines, with no removals or default lifecycle/caller changes.

Exact source `19a681f03ec1c62e26ff328dd3f983e07e52986a` validation:

- 14 focused controls and all 658 server tests passed; full TypeScript, targeted errors-only ESLint and diff checks passed.
- Eight ownership/readiness mutants failed on assertions; restored source passed the focused controls again.
- [Independent lifecycle/source QA](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/blob/f58e882db692463f9d5c42450aa55cd338e2ce0d/docs/qa-transfer/2026-11-20/reports/3720-owned-listeners-19a681f03-review.md) verified exact equality to the approved d64 additions and [immutable proof](https://github.com/Agent-Clubhouse/Clubhouse/tree/90df17c24941444e90d2ef19a92af1a890706837/docs/implementation-notes/3720-owned-listeners), retaining 32 seals and 19 command receipts.
- Missing-API red is test-only credit. Original untracked runs and constructor-fixture failures remain historical; the named-import fixture correction and final source attribution are explicit.

The 14 helper cases model net.Server listening/close events without OS binds or teardown credit. RL-1 uses sequential writes through a real settings-store queue and temporary primary file, with modeled listeners and settings/profile facades; it does not exercise actual SAVE/MCP/Ask/grants or RS1–5. Consumers, independent client-off/control effects after TLS failure, private-port-only corruption, full app/OS teardown, naming activation, live and release acceptance remain deferred. A false predicate alone is never STOP permission or caller/commit/intent authority. Hosted exact-head CI remains required.
